title: Sign-encoded Boolean functions of bounded degree
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $d$, let $\mathcal{C}_{n,d}$ be the set of functions $F:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$ for which there is a Boolean function $f$ on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ of algebraic degree at most $d$ such that $F$ is the real sign encoding of $f$.
